newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca says Accolate sales 8 mln stg in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca says Accolate sales 8 mln stg in 1996.

text.p: Zeneca Group Plc said its newly-launched asthma drug Accolate achieved sales of 8 million stg in the first few weeks of its launch.
Accolate is a new class of treatment for mild asthma, taken in tablet form rather than via an inhaler.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, chief executive David Barnes said that in the first six to seven weeks that the drug had been available in the U.S. it had received 130,000 prescriptions from doctors and showed signs of being well received.
The progress of Accolate will be closely watched by SmithKline Beecham Plc and Merck & Co, both of which have similar products under development.
